desc: STATIC RESULT 2026-07-25 (claude, fresh-attempt pass): STILL OPEN / R3 STILL NO-GO. Items 1, 2 and 6 are not all FOUND, so 096 does not close. Per-item: (1) VBUS-off NOT FOUND - the driver has no VBUS primitive in EITHER direction; setAccessoryPower is a kIOReturnUnsupported stub in both class families, no VBUS/role/source 4CC exists, no VBUS platform function exists, and Type10 turnOnVbus() is only fWaitingForUSB=false + stopUSBTimer + forcePortEvaluation (its caller is driverStatusInterrupt, i.e. it is the USB-host-driver-ready ack). (2) The 0x14 OR-mutation PREMISE IS VOID - the ORs land on a stack buffer / the software cache at this+0xf28 and are handed to processInterruptEvents (slot +0xb38); register 0x14 is never written anywhere in the kext. The cached/W1C ownership protocol IS now fully decoded (this+0xf28 cache, this+0xf66 valid, this+0xf59 defer gate). The 0x18 W1C consumption remains irreversible and provably has no inverse. (3) Mask/detect restoration NOT FOUND - setInterruptMask writes a synthesized constant 07 0d 00 00 02 {00|10} c0 {0b|8b} to 0x16, never reads 0x16, never saves the prior value; the real HAL RMW is unreachable from AppleTCController; no path restores a saved detect state. (4) Pre-SSPS 0x07 NOT FOUND - Type10-reachable SSPS args are exactly {0,2,3}; 0x07 is never passed and never appears as an SSPS payload; register 0x20 is read-only to the driver. (5) 0x23/0x24/0x55 NOT FOUND and OUT OF SCOPE - all four accesses live in HALType5 wrappers whose only six call sites are in Type16/Type17, which gate on hpm-class-type 16/17 and are unreachable from class 10; 0x24 is never written, 0x55 is never read, neutral 0x55 remains unproven. (6) Cross-layer teardown order NOT FOUND, structurally: Apple performs NO cross-layer teardown on detach - processModeFlags is a pure software object reconciler (reads 0x48/0x49, no writes), the eUSB2 repeaterReset ('EURr' via platform-function 4CC 'prst', payload domain {0,1,2}) has no caller anywhere in the corpus, eusb2phy_shutdown is known-off rather than a byte-preserving or even complete bit inverse of init, PHY teardown is driven by client refcount/close not cable detach, and xHCI orders against the PHY only on driver stop. NEW POSITIVE EVIDENCE: the HPM-layer detach/reattach order IS fully specified and bidirectional via AppleTCControllerType10::overrideHPMMode(enforce, keepRoleAndOrientation, dataStatus, status) @0xfffffe000952c3bc, reachable by IOKit message selector 0xe3ff843f with a decoded arg struct, and the pre-transition values are readable from this+0xee8/this+0xef0. The complete class-10 mutation surface of that whole chain is exactly TWO hardware ops: a blind unsaved writeReg(0x50, 00 20 00 00, 4) in clearDpIRQ(), and the getAndClearInterrupt(0x14->0x18, 9) W1C. Neither has an inverse in Apple's code. CORRECTIONS: done/2026-07-24-t6040-hpm-class10-host-transition.md's 'write address 0x14, length 9' is a mis-decode of the slot-+0xb38 virtual call and is withdrawn; the 0x55 logical bits 3 and 4 are transposed on the wire; Sol's Type10 vtable slot table is independently CONFIRMED correct. Method additions now reusable: PAC-diversifier-checked vtable decoding (__ZTV + 0x10 + slot; VA = 0xfffffe0007004000 + (raw & 0xffffffff)), slot +0xb08 = writeReg and +0xb10 = execute4Cc, and the 4CC command channel (codes are 32-bit immediates written to CMD1 = register 0x08, invisible to strings). RISK FRAMING UNCHANGED: this is a completeness verdict, not a danger claim; the exhaustive write inventory independently confirms no flash/OTP/non-volatile path in the class-10 surface, so both irreversible ops are volatile state cleared by a power cycle (see done/2026-07-25-t6040-r3-risk-calibration.md). Do not build or run 102-108 on this evidence. To close 096 still needs: primary evidence that a saved register-0x50 word can be safely written back (it has at least one W1C-style bit), a decided position on the 0x18 W1C, and either a validated cross-layer composition order or a design that needs none. Evidence: done/2026-07-25-t6040-hpm2-rollback-evidence.md (supersedes the per-item conclusions in done/2026-07-24-t6040-hpm2-detach-static-slice.md, whose slot table it confirms).
